title: Dark-accent visual direction
summary: One saturated signature accent doing all the identity work against a near-black canvas, for apps that read as dark, moody, or nocturnal.
defaults: Hue: one saturated signature accent (Spotify green #1DB954 in the reference) reserved for primary actions, active states, and identity marks
Surface: near-black canvas (#121212 range) with slightly raised dark surfaces and near-white body text (#EAEAEA range)
Density: relaxed consumer spacing with generous media-first blocks
Keep the accent off large backgrounds: it marks one primary button, highlights, and state only
risks: Accent bleeding across large surfaces and losing its identity role
A second hue competing with the signature accent on the dark canvas
verification: One brand accent hue supports primary actions and highlights; preserve meaningful status/data colors
Body text reaches 4.5:1 contrast on the near-black surface
Brand neutrals avoid pure #000000 or #FFFFFF unless the user explicitly requests them

example_startups.name: Spotify
example_startups.note: Single signature green carrying all identity against a near-black canvas

visual_rules: For brand decoration, prefer one signature accent used sparingly for identity and primary actions
Use a cohesive neutral palette; family tones are suggestions, not limits on explicit user design choices
Keep ordinary text, including button labels, at least 4.5:1 contrast and controls/focus states visible
Keep decorative hues restrained; retain colors needed for status, data distinctions, or explicit user requirements
